tools.name: grade_config
tools.description: Grade an AI coding agent permissions config (Claude Code .claude/settings.json, Gemini CLI .gemini/settings.json, mcp.json, or Codex CLI config.toml). Returns a letter grade, findings, a safer config and README badge Markdown. Inputs are not stored or logged.

tools.name: get_index_stats
tools.description: Headline aggregate numbers from the latest weekly snapshot of public AI agent configs on GitHub.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Agent tools ranked by how safely their public configs are set up, with sample sizes and method.
